title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On 1 October 2024 in Zurich Oerlikon, a 23 year old Chinese university student attacked three five year old boys at a childcare centre with a knife. The blade was about 8.5 centimetres long. One boy had a major vein at his collarbone completely severed and needed emergency surgery. A second was stabbed twice in the chest, damaging his heart sac and major blood vessels, and barely survived. The third suffered injuries to his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, he dropped the knife and surrendered, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences and choosing children as targets. He ordered clothes and a set of kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and bought raw beef to practise stabbing. He acted on China's national day and posted patriotic messages shortly before. The prosecution has charged him with attempted murder and is seeking a 15 year prison sentence and a 15 year expulsion from Switzerland. His trial is scheduled for Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
